notes.subject: go daun long graun pastaim
notes.rationale: ושתחוה is full body prostration in homage, not merely 'worship' in the heart — Tok Pisin keeps the bodily picture.

notes.subject: man
notes.rationale: האיש with definite article — 'the man', the servant of Avraham; Tok Pisin has no article so it is unmarked.

translation: Na man bilong pait i brukim hed bilong en, na em i go daun long graun pastaim long Yahwe.
